prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1228; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the rear-end collision you reported in Pasadena, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's okay.

Q: That's fine. For the record, can you confirm you were the driver of the vehicle that was struck from behind?

A: Yes, I was driving. I was stopped at a red light on the main road when I felt the impact.

Q: Where were you headed, and what was the traffic like at the time?

A: I was heading to the grocery store. Traffic was moderate, nothing unusual. The light had been red for a while, and I'd come to a full stop.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. I checked my mirror just before I stopped, and it looked like it was still back a ways. Then there was a hard jolt from behind.

Q: Did you get out of your vehicle at the scene?

A: I got out to look at the car, but I didn't feel steady, so I sat back down until the police arrived.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes. I went to an urgent care clinic that afternoon. They said I had whiplash. My neck is stiff, and I've had headaches and pain in my upper back.

Q: Are you currently receiving any treatment or taking any medication for those symptoms?

A: I'm seeing a physical therapist twice a week, and I take something for the pain when it gets bad. Sleeping has been hard too.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Just that I'm trying to get back to normal. I didn't do anything to cause this, and I'm hoping this gets resolved soon.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
